extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors / contributors (especially those working on biographies of living persons)
extracted.subtask_description: Improving and maintaining the Jo Koy Wikipedia biography to meet Wikipedia content and style policies: add reliable sources, remove or tag original research, fix citation formatting, and follow site-wide style (language/date) conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biography of a living person: add citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Please help by adding reliable sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous. The page itself includes a 'Find sources' prompt ('"Jo Koy" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR (January 2025)') indicating editors should locate reliable coverage to support statements. Focus on adding inline citations from trustworthy secondary sources (news, books, reputable publications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove or verify original research
rubrics_metrics.description: This section may contain original research. Please improve it by verifying the claims made and adding inline citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements consisting only of original research should be removed. If a claim cannot be supported by a reliable published source, either reword it to reflect what sources say or delete it. Verify chronology, factual assertions, and unique claims with citations before retaining them in the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix improperly formatted inline citations
rubrics_metrics.description: This article includes inline citations, but they are not properly formatted. Please improve this article by correcting them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure references use consistent citation templates, that inline footnotes correspond to full references, and that archived links/URLs, access dates, and author/publication metadata are present where applicable. There is an explicit maintenance tag requesting correction of citation formatting; address citation style and footnote reformatting accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to site style: language and date formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Use American English from January 2025. Use mdy dates from January 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow Wikipedia's language and date-style conventions for this article (American English spelling and month-day-year date format). Apply consistent spelling, punctuation, and date formatting throughout the article and in references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address maintenance-category issues (unsourced statements, vague/dated content, wikify)
rubrics_metrics.description: The article is in multiple maintenance/hidden categories such as: All articles with unsourced statements; All BLP articles lacking sources; Articles that may contain original research; Articles with vague or ambiguous time; Articles containing potentially dated statements; Articles needing footnote reformatting; Articles covered by WikiProject Wikify.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systematically resolve the listed maintenance problems: add citations for unsourced statements, clarify ambiguous time periods (replace 'recently' or 'as of 2023' with exact dates and citations), remove or tag material that appears to be original research, reformat footnotes, and perform general wikification (improve prose, sectioning, lead summary). Use relevant WikiProject guidance (BLP policy, verifiability, no original research) when making changes.
